description: Poco Leok protest on 2 Oct has no usable estimate of simultaneous attendance; opened coverage says 'several residents' but does not prove 50.
required_followup: Find permissible contemporaneous reporting or an original account with a count or clear mass-scale description.

description: Bekasi action on 28 Oct is supported only by search-result excerpts. Its relation to Jakarta's 24 Oct nationally organized wage wave and its own simultaneous turnout are unresolved; ANTARA's separate page displayed an AI crawling/indexing notice, so no ANTARA body request was made for this URL.
required_followup: Use a permitted non-ANTARA full article or contemporaneous source; assess if local action belongs to the national campaign or is separate.

description: For Poco Leok, government/state-company involvement and an explicit request for state action are supported only by search-only advocacy material; exact demand target needs body-level evidence.
required_followup: Find an accessible body source specifying the demand and government role.

description: The 24 Oct labor demonstration was described as the start of a nationwide wave through 31 Oct and threatened a November strike, but this bounded dossier verifies only the Jakarta rally plus search-only leads for later local actions. Final active date and local-to-national episode boundary are unknown.
required_followup: Review dated local reports from 25–31 Oct and after 31 Oct; do not convert planned totals or strike dates into observed activity.

description: Research is labor-heavy and centered on Jakarta, East Nusa Tenggara and Bekasi; no systematic province-by-province sweep or broad search across non-labor sectors was completed.
required_followup: Continue regional searches across provinces and land, environmental, education, health, price and political-process issues.

description: Open-web search is not equivalent to the original LexisNexis workflow; publisher archives, full source universe and native query totals/timestamps are unavailable.
required_followup: Coordinator may compare with baseline archives if authorized; do not claim exhaustiveness.

description: The 8 Oct Serang report identifies three successive student organizations and official discussions but gives no simultaneous attendance for any one group; none can yet be coded as reaching 50.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous event-specific attendance evidence for each group or retain pending_threshold.

description: The Serang government report separates HMI, PMII and Aliansi Mahasiswa as three successive waves on 8 Oct at one office. Their group demands and attendance are incompletely specified, so the correct event grouping remains unresolved.
required_followup: Compare independent accounts or organizational records to determine whether these were distinct assemblies or components of one broader action; do not aggregate turnout without proof of simultaneous attendance.
